title: Direct-image exchange, finite coefficients
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and chosen uniformizer $\varpi$, and let $n\geq1$ be an integer. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n$, with the coefficient datum of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $\square$ be a Cartesian square of schemes with arrows $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$ and $g':X'\to X$, so $fg'=gf'$. For a scheme $T$, $D(T_{\Proet},A)$ denotes the unbounded derived category of sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A$ on the small pro-etale site of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the finite-coefficient derived adjunction of [def-sfb-finite-derived-adjunction], specialized to the coefficient category of $A$-modules.

The finite-coefficient direct-image exchange for $\square$ is the natural transformation

$$
\operatorname{Ex}_{*,\square,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}:
Lg^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}Rf_{*,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}
\longrightarrow Rf'_{*,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}Lg'^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}
$$

of functors $D(X_{\Proet},\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)\to D(Y'_{\Proet},\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)$ whose component at $K$ is the adjoint, under [def-sfb-finite-derived-adjunction] for $f'$, of

$$
Lf'^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}Lg^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}Rf_{*,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}K
\xrightarrow{c_{\square,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}}
Lg'^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}Lf^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}Rf_{*,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}K
\xrightarrow{Lg'^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}\varepsilon_{f,K}}Lg'^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}K,
$$

where $\varepsilon_f$ is the counit of [def-sfb-finite-derived-adjunction] for $f$ and $c_{\square,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}$ is Definition [pur713-def-pullback-comparison]. No invertibility is asserted.
